item.description:
twenty one pilots - Scaled and Icy [Livestream Experience] (1080p HD)


​
The twenty one pilots Livestream Experience was a groundbreaking, Emmy-nominated virtual concert broadcast globally on May 21, 2021, to celebrate the release of the duo's sixth studio album, Scaled and Icy. Directed by Jason Zada, the production was framed as a dystopian television broadcast produced by the fictional, oppressive authorities of "Dema," the central setting of the band's ongoing lore. Hosted by two eerie, forced-smiling anchors named Dan Lisden and Sally Sacarver, the show featured abrupt, unsettling commercial breaks that directly interrupted the music to underscore the theme of psychological control.
​


More information: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt14717082/
